title: Controllers: where the controller's input stops on the way to the Arisen (watch only)
intro: Game window in front, no co-op, not playing a pawn. Press End (keyboard) when ready.

steps.text: Controller A: hold the left stick forward, then press Cross a few times.
steps.each_frame:
if not G_pb then
  G_pb = { n = 0, nz = 0, last = 0, kb = 0 }
  local td = sdk.find_type_definition("app.UserInput")
  local m = td and td:get_method("processButton")
  if m then sdk.hook(m, function(args)
      G_pb.n = G_pb.n + 1
      local ok, v = pcall(sdk.to_int64, args[4])
      if ok and v and v ~= 0 then G_pb.nz = G_pb.nz + 1; G_pb.last = v end
    end, function(r) return r end) end
  local m2 = td and td:get_method("processKeyboardMouse")
  if m2 then sdk.hook(m2, function(args) G_pb.kb = G_pb.kb + 1 end, function(r) return r end) end
end

probes.pads:
local o = {}
pcall(function() o[#o + 1] = "mode=" .. tostring(sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.UserInputManager"):call("get_HIDInputMode")) end)
pcall(function()
  local inp = sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.CharacterManager"):call("get_ManualPlayer"):call("get_Input")
  o[#o + 1] = string.format("arisen=%X mag=%.2f", inp:get_field("ButtonOnFlags") or 0, inp:call("get_AxisMagnitudeL") or 0)
end)
pcall(function()
  local gp = sdk.get_native_singleton("via.hid.GamePad"); local td = sdk.find_type_definition("via.hid.GamePad")
  local arr = sdk.call_native_func(gp, td, "get_ConnectingDevices")
  for i = 0, arr:call("get_Count") - 1 do local dv = arr:call("get_Item", i); o[#o + 1] = string.format("d%d=%X", i, dv:call("get_Button") or 0) end
end)
local R = _G.DPC_dbg and _G.DPC_dbg.R
if R then o[#o + 1] = "fixes=" .. tostring(R.tp.pm_fixes or 0) .. " coop=" .. tostring(R.api_table.state().coop.active) end
if G_pb then o[#o + 1] = string.format("pb=%d nonzero=%d last=%X kbm=%d", G_pb.n, G_pb.nz, G_pb.last, G_pb.kb) end
return table.concat(o, " ")
